ifYou: If this was you, you do not need to do anything.
secureHelp: The button opens a page where you can choose a new password. After that, open Vaultara, go to Profile > Security and privacy > Your devices and tap Sign out of all other devices.
support: Reply to this email or contact {supportEmail}.
securityFooter: We send this email to keep your Vaultara account safe. You cannot turn these emails off.
billingFooter: We send this email so you always know what is happening with your Vaultara subscription.
newSignInSubject: New sign-in to your Vaultara account
newSignInBody: Your Vaultara account was just signed in to from a device we have not seen before.
passwordChangedBody: The password for your Vaultara account was just changed.
emailChangeRequestedSubject: A request to change your Vaultara email
emailChangeRequestedBody: A request was made to change the email on your account.
emailChangeRequestedBodyTo: A request was made to change the email on your account to {maskedNewEmail}.
twoStepDisabledBody: Two-step verification was just turned off for your Vaultara account. Signing in now only needs your password.
sessionsRevokedSubject: You were signed out of your other devices
sessionsRevokedBody: Your Vaultara account was just signed out on all devices except the one used to make this change.
includedPremium: Premium includes unlimited records and categories, photo attachments, share links and advanced reminders.
includedFamily: Family includes everything in Premium, plus shared records and reminders for your whole household.
includedBusiness: Business includes everything in Family, plus staff reminders, update requests and compliance reports.
receiptGoogle: Google Play sends your official receipt with the amount charged.
receiptApple: Apple sends your official receipt with the amount charged.
startedBody: Thank you for subscribing. Your {plan} plan is now active.
renewedBody: Your {plan} plan was renewed. Thank you for staying with Vaultara.
yearlyReminderSubject: Your Vaultara {plan} plan renews in 7 days
yearlyReminderBody: Your yearly {plan} plan renews on {date}. If you want to keep it, you do not need to do anything. If you want to change or cancel it, you can do that before the renewal date.
cancelledSubject: Your Vaultara {plan} plan will not renew
cancelledBody: Auto-renew is now off for your {plan} plan. You keep full access until {date}. After that, your account moves to the Free plan and your records stay safe.
resumedSubject: Your Vaultara {plan} plan will renew again
resumedBody: Auto-renew is on again for your {plan} plan. Thank you for staying with Vaultara.
endedBody: Your {plan} plan has ended and your account is now on the Free plan. Your records are still in your account. You can subscribe again at any time from the app.
refundedBody: A purchase of your {plan} plan was refunded. Access that came with this purchase has ended.
deleteBody: We received a request to delete the Vaultara account that uses this email address. To continue, open the link below. You can review what will be deleted before you confirm.
deleteExpiry: The link works once and expires in 1 hour.
deleteNotYou: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your account stays exactly as it is.
deleteFooter: We send this email because someone asked to delete the Vaultara account for this address.
